fact: The ISP-CAPEM project, approved on 28 November 2023, will pay for a consultant to monitor and supervise the development and implementation of the upgraded Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS, new SAFE-e).
title: EOI - Sao Tome and Principe - Individual Consultancy for the monitoring and supervising the development and implementation of the upgraded Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS, new SAFE-e) - ISP-CAPEM
